thread:
carla-cs: Heads up — customer acct-1821 hitting 400s on /v1/rerank in prod since yesterday. Error in logs: \"400 Bad Request: invalid number\". They attached the request body and say it used to work.

mike-eng: Can you paste the exact payload (redact keys) and SDK/version if available?

carla-cs: Pasted payload from logs:
```json
{
  \"query\": \"best pizza near me\",
  \"items\": [
    {\"id\": \"a1\", \"text\": \"Margherita\", \"score\": \"0.92,0.03\"},
    {\"id\": \"a2\", \"text\": \"Pepperoni\", \"score\": \"0.85\"}
  ]
}
```
They said client lib updated this morning (internal aggregator change). SDK header: "sdk-js/2.3.4" per request logs.

vik-oncall: Quick triage: schema expects items[].score to be a number (or omitted). Looks like their serializer joins numeric arrays/values with commas into a string. That will fail our strict JSON number parsing.

support-bot: Request meta: acct-1821, api-key-***, region us-west-2, sdk-js/2.3.4, src-ip 34.78.12.9 — logged at 1769998610.

mike-eng: Repro locally: curl to /v1/rerank with that body -> 400 response body: {\"error\":\"invalid number at items[0].score\"}. So behavior is expected. But customer claims no change on our side. Likely client-side lib altered.

carla-cs: Customer insists it worked last week. They asked if we can accept comma-separated numeric strings as fallback for a short term.

mike-eng: Short-term workaround: tell them to coerce score to number or remove the score field before calling. We'll not silently coerce at platform level — risk of ambiguity. I'll add a clearer error message to help them debug.

vik-oncall: I'll ping the SDK team to check whether sdk-js/2.3.4 introduced a serializer bug. @sdk-team please look for code that stringifies numeric arrays/values.

mike-eng: Filed ENG-5678: "Improve rerank request validation error message + investigate client-side serializations". Adding link to this thread.

rerank-bot: Created ticket ENG-5678 and linked thread (priority P2).

carla-cs: Sent customer the workaround (strip/convert scores). They will test and revert. :thumbsup:

mike-eng: Follow-up plan: (1) improve error text to indicate offending field path, (2) add a short doc blurb with common SDK serializer pitfalls, (3) if multiple customers affected, consider tolerant parsing with a strictness flag.

carla-cs: Customer confirmed workaround fixed their calls in staging. Closing after they verify prod. Thanks all.
